blocks.title: SlotGuard store
blocks.description: Persists owners, services, slots, appointments, payment references, and an audit of deposit state changes.

blocks.title: Booking engine
blocks.description: Creates appointments against availability and prevents double-booking. Concurrency rules are open.

blocks.title: Public booking page
blocks.description: Client picks a service and a time, enters contact details, and sees the deposit amount and cancel policy before paying.

blocks.title: Deposit checkout
blocks.description: Collects the deposit and shows success and an appointment summary. In this demo build checkout is a mock: every deposit is confirmed and no money is charged. Failure and retry behavior are not specified.

blocks.title: Pricing model
blocks.description: Undecided: flat SaaS per location, a percentage of deposits, or a hybrid. Must be settled with market research before the strategy is locked.

blocks.title: Deposit rules
blocks.description: Undecided: deposit amount (percent of the service or a fixed amount), cancel cutoff (for example 24 hours), keep 100% or part on a late cancel, and how no-shows are handled.

blocks.title: Notifications
blocks.description: Sends booking confirmed, reminder, and cancel outcomes. Email first. SMS is undecided.

blocks.title: Client
blocks.description: Booker. May be a guest (email or phone only) in v1.

blocks.title: Payments provider
blocks.description: Undecided: Stripe (cards, payment intents) or another provider. Affects webhooks, refunds, and the docs pack. The demo build uses a mock.

blocks.title: Owner
blocks.description: The paying customer. Login and business profile now, payout settings later.

blocks.title: Owner dashboard
blocks.description: Lists today's and upcoming appointments with the deposit status: authorized, captured, refunded, or forfeited.

blocks.title: Deposit & refunds
blocks.description: Creates the deposit, then handles capture, refund, and forfeit per the deposit rules. The demo build uses a mock provider that always confirms. A real provider needs webhook verification.

blocks.title: Cancel / reschedule
blocks.description: Client cancels or reschedules. The system applies the refund or keep rules based on the cutoff.

blocks.title: Product intent
blocks.description: Independent salons, clinics, tutors, and studios (1–5 chairs or rooms) lose money on no-shows. SlotGuard sells to the owner: booking link, deposit rules, and a dashboard. Not a full salon OS.

blocks.title: Services & availability
blocks.description: Owner defines services, prices, durations, and open hours. v1 can be minimal.

blocks.title: Appointment
blocks.description: Service, time, client, and the deposit state machine.
